items.prompt: Create a distinctive brand logo symbol for a Chinese file transfer product. The symbol shows a realistic human arm carrying a large envelope. The arm must have fully visible, naturally curved fingers that clearly grip or hold the envelope, making it unmistakably a human arm. Use the current warm malt candy visual language: amber orange, honey caramel, soft rounded shapes, subtle translucent glass or maltose jelly highlights, gentle dimensionality, but mostly flat and iconic. The envelope is large with a triangular flap, in amber and caramel tones. No readable text, no letters, no numbers, no Chinese characters, no watermark. No face, no full person, no realistic skin texture, no office folder, no cloud icon. Use a very light warm cream background only for presentation. Centered composition, clean silhouette, high legibility at 32px and app icon size. Composition: A single rounded amber arm forms a smooth U-shaped hook over the top-left edge of an oversized envelope with a clear triangular flap. All five fingers are fully visible, naturally curved and gripping the envelope edge. The envelope feels like a soft malt candy pouch, compact, friendly, flat logo style.
